name: project
description: Project document lifecycle: stakeholder proposals, kickoff and Entry Pages, evidence-backed progress updates, closeout and document review.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare and maintain project lifecycle documents.
interface.longDescription: Prepare stakeholder proposals, build kickoff agreements and a Project Entry Page, maintain current progress with source evidence, and close out delivery and lessons. Resume from existing records; preserve approval boundaries, original commitments and outstanding measurement. Includes document review, source discovery and context packs. Product owns roadmap status and Develop owns engineering delivery.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this project proposal for stakeholder review.
Turn this approved proposal into kickoff material and an Entry Page.
Update this project page and preserve the approved baseline.
Review project delivery, results and lessons for closeout.
